name: Requirements Blueprint
purpose: A visual aid to frame a set of high-level requirements to create meaningful and worthwhile outcomes (results).
whereUsed: The Requirements Blueprint is best used in the Problem Space during the Analysis Phase (2.2) to “Design a Blueprint”. It’s also useful in the Solution Space to confirm solutions and address business requirements.
why: We will have a shared visual design that represents what it takes to achieve desired outcomes. That design will permit us to more quickly offer meaningful solutions.
outcomes: Confirmation that complex business environments require complete, intentional approaches
Agreement among stakeholders to a high-level set of requirements to address the problems impacting the business

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Review and agree to the need for a blueprint to solve business problems
Agree that multiple parties are needed to realize outcomes
Establish who/how each of the major blueprint components is currently addressed
Brainstorm and illustrate how current needs/gaps can be addressed with various capabilities

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Validate the solution under consideration fits into the short and long-term set of requirements for the organization
Reaffirm commitment to the blueprint’s essential role in ensuring everyone is working to the same picture
Demonstrate how the initiative or solution contributes to the blueprint
Document any recently disclosed requirements gaps
